name: What types of spaces can be incorporated into a bathroom expansion?

mainEntity.name: What types of spaces can be incorporated into a bathroom expansion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common spaces incorporated into a bathroom expansion include adjacent closets, portions of a large bedroom, underutilized hallway areas, or even small, rarely used rooms. The feasibility depends on the home's existing layout and structural considerations. For example, a walk-in closet next to a primary bathroom is often a prime candidate for conversion into a larger shower, toilet area, or additional vanity space. A design-build team can identify optimal solutions for your specific property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Adjacent closets, parts of large bedrooms, or underutilized hallway areas are common spaces that can be incorporated into a bathroom expansion.
